verdict.rationale: The closest evidence is task suites, which group many tasks so one evaluation run executes them all against an agent version or a baseline-vs-candidate comparison. SDKs in several languages let users script repeated operations themselves. Neither is a documented general bulk-operation capability (e.g., bulk edit, delete or update across selected items). Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch endpoints or UI multi-select actions, batch APIs for tasks, worlds or records, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
